body:
## What this ticket is

This WeGoTrip listing sells admission to **Aquaria Phuket**, an indoor aquarium on the B1 floor of the Central Phuket Floresta shopping mall in Phuket Town (address on the page: 199 Moo.4 T. Wichit, A. Muang Phuket 83000). The only listed inclusion is entry to the aquarium. Food, drinks, special activities and souvenirs are excluded.

The listing describes daily hand-feeding sessions for otters, stingrays and penguins, themed zones such as the Mystic Forest (freshwater fish) and Jewels of the Jungle (reptiles), and a main South China Sea exhibit that, according to the page, holds more than 3.5 million litres of seawater. It was rated **4.0 out of 5 from 13 ratings and 6 reviews** when we read it on 11 November 2026.

## Prices: read the categories carefully

The headline price on the page is **from €18.34** (€15.59 with a WeGoTrip subscription), but that figure is the **Thai Citizen & Expats** adult rate. The booking data listed these categories:

- **International Visitor, 140 cm and over:** €35.35
- **International Visitor, 90 to 139 cm:** €19.59
- **Thai Citizen & Expats, 140 cm and over:** €18.34
- **Thai Citizen & Expats, 90 to 139 cm:** €11.20
- **Aquaria + AR Trickeye Museum combo:** €38.36 adult and €24.86 child for international visitors; €23.19 and €14.68 for residents

Children below 90 cm enter free. The resident rate is not a loophole: the listing says expats must show a Thai work permit or Thai driver's licence at the entrance. A holidaymaker should budget for the International Visitor price.

## How entry works

You show the mobile voucher together with your passport, ID card or work permit to redeem the ticket. The page notes the product has time slots, so pick your visit time at checkout.

## What to check before booking

- **House rules:** no outside food or drinks, and no suitcases, drones or sharp objects. If you are coming straight from the airport with luggage, store it first.
- **Photography:** flash is not allowed inside.
- **Feeding times:** the listing points to a feeding-time page, but the link on the listing is broken. Check the schedule with the aquarium before you go if the feeding sessions are the reason you are visiting.
- **Cancellation:** the product page does not state a cancellation window; read the conditions shown at checkout.
- **Rainy days:** being indoors under a mall, it works as a fallback on days when the weather rules out the beach.
